routes.evidenceSummary: Official page titled Speculative Application invites applicants whose experience fits even when no listed role does. Guildford, UK.
Official careers page asks applicants to send their CV and details as a speculative application when no current role fits.
Official ATS route for speculative applications when no specific role fits. Listed as flexi-hybrid with remote options in the UK/EU.
Official Personio posting is titled speculative application; it says applicants who did not find a fitting role can apply anyway. Munich office.
Official ATS listing titled Unsolicited Application; remote work is limited to time zones roughly 1–2 hours from Copenhagen.
Official ATS route welcomes speculative applications across disciplines. Hybrid in Southampton; applicants must already have UK right to work and sponsorship is unavailable.
Official page says 'Apply anyway', is open to all departments, fully remote and reviewed all year; it describes its speculative application process.
Official careers page invites speculative resumes, says the studio is 100% remote, and shows a speculative application open to all departments any time.
Official careers page has a Speculative Application section and invites people without a matching role to contact the studio.
Official page is titled Speculative Application and asks applicants to send a CV and portfolio if possible.
Official careers page invites applications beyond listed roles; applicants choose Open application in the form. Studio office is in Istanbul.
Official careers page lists Open application alongside role listings; the studio describes its work model as remote-friendly.
Official Open Application welcomes candidates even if no exact role is listed. Marked Worldwide and Fully Remote; considers current or future project needs.
Official General Application is for experienced contributors whose skills do not match a listed role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis; location is Global.
Official Unsolicited Application welcomes candidates without a matching role. Remote-first company asks for an English CV and cover letter; country eligibility is not specified.
Official Spontaneous Application accepts worldwide applicants. Caveat: project-based freelance with points-based profit share, no guaranteed upfront salary or fee.
Official careers page invites CVs if no open position fits. Most work is Lyon-based; some roles allow remote from Lyon. Unsolicited eligibility is not stated.
Official unsolicited form covers art, programming, design, production, audio, QA and more; applicants explain why they want to work on UNRECORD.
Official careers page describes a fully remote, globally distributed indie studio and invites General Applications when no role fits. Country eligibility is unstated.
Branded open-application page welcomes a resume even when no suitable listed position fits. Applicant-country eligibility and work arrangements are not specified.
Saudi-based G7 Studio has a General Application for game development and future opportunities; roles and working arrangements can be discussed if there's a fit.
Official careers page has a Speculative Application section and invites candidates to contact careers@aweinteractive.com. Work location and eligibility are unstated.
Official listing invites unsolicited CVs when no role matches. Listed as hybrid in Aarhus, Denmark; broader applicant-country eligibility is not stated.
Official careers page says it is always meeting good people and links a Spontaneous Application for candidates whose role is not listed.
Official page invites spontaneous applications by email. Requires fluent English and Italian and availability to work on site in Milan, Italy.
Official Greenhouse General Application accepts candidates for future opportunities. Team is globally distributed; eligible hiring countries are not listed.
Official site invites CV and portfolio emails for developers, artists, designers and other contributors. Reykjavík-based studio describes a remote-first work environment.
Official careers page says there are no open roles but welcomes open applications by email with a CV or portfolio and a note about the candidate's interests.
Official careers page invites spontaneous applications and says remote work can be done from anywhere. Some freelance roles prefer Europe-friendly time zones.
Official careers page invites spontaneous applications if no listed role fits. Current freelance roles are remote; speculative applicant eligibility is not stated.
Official Open Application covers general disciplines and explicitly lists Remote: Global for people passionate about the game industry.
Official careers page says there are no open roles right now but accepts speculative applications from people who believe they fit.
Official careers page hires ahead of need and welcomes introductions by email when no opening fits. Remote-friendly game, XR and partner projects; eligibility is unstated.
Official Recruitee listing welcomes applications when no listed specialty matches; options include on-site, remote or hybrid around Montréal and Québec, Canada.
Official Open Application asks applicants without a matching role to email a resume. Preferred locations are Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne and/or remote.
Official Québec careers page lists a Spontaneous Application and invites interested candidates to send an English CV and cover letter.
Official careers page invites spontaneous applications for roles in Portugal or remote, including full-time, part-time, contract and freelance.
Official website includes an Open Application alongside role listings and invites candidates to apply by email.
Budapest-based adult FMV studio has a General Application for game dev, design and DevOps. Form explicitly asks applicants to confirm comfort with adult content.
Official jobs page lists an Open Application for people interested in AI-native games and game creation; studio is in Helsinki and eligibility is unstated.
Official jobs page invites speculative approaches when no role fits. Employment is Germany-only; freelancers can usually work from European time zones.
Official Open Application for Helsinki hybrid roles. Accepts EU/EEA/Swiss citizens or people already authorised to work in Finland; no visa sponsorship.
Official Teamtailor Open Application; fully remote from Tallinn. Applicants outside Moldova or Estonia must be willing to use a B2B contract.
Official careers page invites open applications beyond listed roles. Small, fully remote Minecraft studio; typical roles specify a GMT ±6-hour window.
Official Ashby General Interest application welcomes candidates without a matching role. Global remote; EU and Canada preferred, others considered by role.
Official careers page invites open applications with a portfolio or work samples. Remote across Europe with CET overlap; specific roles are also listed.
Official General Application for future opportunities. Remote-first, but applicants must live in and have permission to work in the US or UK.
Official Unsolicited Application accepts candidates when no role is open. On-site, hybrid or remote; English required, German for full-time roles.
Official careers page offers a spontaneous-application form when no listed role fits; candidates can attach a CV and portfolio. Work model is not stated.
Official General Application invites future-role applications across disciplines. Important caveat: the studio states its work is rev-share-based.
